test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which is the correct formula for median of grouped data?

Consider:

L = lower limit of median class

CF₀ = cumulative frequency of preceding class

F = frequency of median class

H = class width

N = the total of frequency
solution:
**Definitions:**

 
• **L:** Lower limit of the median class
 
• **CF₀:** Cumulative frequency of the class preceding the median class
 
• **F:** Frequency of the median class
 
• **H:** Class width
 
• **N:** Total frequency of all classes

**Median Formula:**

Median = L + ((N/2 - CF₀) / F) × H
